address: Cökertme Caddesi No:36, Yalıkavak Marina, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
bio: Zuma is not at all out of place among the impressive yachts and luxury boutiques. This izakaya has a sophisticated feel with its phenomenal sea views, clubby vibe and laid-back atmosphere. From May to October, this is the place to discover a trendy take on Japanese cuisine, in which the robata grill and sushi take centre stage. They serve a variety of nigiri, succulent grilled tiger prawns or teriyaki-marinated grilled salmon with pickled cucumber. Meat lovers might prefer the 700g dry-aged ribeye. The extensive menu is full of irresistible options! Prolong your experience at this hip establishment with a refreshing cocktail at the bar.
